set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: F04.4
Accountable role (person unassigned): Backend/integration engineer with identity administrator
Pilot scope: required

Scope: Verify the deployed identity integration with the institution rather than substituting a mock-provider result.
Work kind: institutional
Acceptance gate: F04 (bd-01M4W40JP4T8D7RY21HG6YKHF3)

Acceptance criteria:
1. Exercise real staff and approved guest sign-in, logout, expiry, deactivation and provider outage in the protected staging deployment.
2. Verify redirect/cookie/origin configuration, institution-side offboarding and secret rotation without committing live credentials.
3. Identity administrator records provider/configuration versions, observed outcomes and remaining limits; missing access remains an open qualification item.

Verification: Redacted source/configuration-bound staging receipt with identity-administrator acceptance.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/F04.4/receipt.json
Evidence must include: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input.

External inputs (never assume supplied):
- Real staging identity provider
- Staff and guest test accounts

Starting code/evidence:
- modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/Authentication.scala
- docs/http-api.md

Blocked by:
- F04.3: bd-01M4W5P64ZQD531177ZZKYVC4K
- SITE01.2: bd-01M4W5P46THC7WFA4FD0B1A68Z
- O01.4: bd-01M4W5P82ESVMAKQCP7FZ8DXP3

Completion rule: satisfy every acceptance criterion with observed evidence. Failed or not-run requirements stay open. Preserve scientific identity/history and current authority; create blocking remediation work for discovered scope. Automated or simulated evidence cannot replace a required institutional or human result. No implementation is claimed by this plan.
